## Informant model

The informant model has 1 indicator, the Jorm IQCODE (Jorm, 1994), treated as continuous. Its mean differs by class, and its variance is equal across classes. The IQCODE is not adjusted for sociodemographic characteristics.

```{r}
pmm_inf_cal <- suppressWarnings(MplusAutomation::readModels(pmm_models$informant$calibration_out, what = "summaries"))
pmm_inf_parameters <- pmm_h5_parameter_table(mplush5::mplus.print.model.results(pmm_models$informant$calibration_h5))
```

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Informant model: sample and fit (known-class calibration)"
pmm_fit_row(pmm_inf_cal, pmm_models$informant$label) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c(Loglikelihood, BIC), decimals = 1) |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = N, decimals = 0)
```

```{r}
#| tbl-cap: "Informant model: Jorm IQCODE mean and variance by class, estimate (SE)"
pmm_par_by_class(pmm_inf_parameters, "^Means$|^Intercepts$|^Variances$") |>
  gt::gt()
```

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Informant model: class probabilities by HRS/HCAP Algorithm class (unweighted)"
pmm_cprob_plot(pmm_read_cprob(pmm_models$informant$scoring_out))
```
